function.arguments: {"observation": "`revenue` is stored as a string with thousands separators (e.g., '1,234.56'), and 6 rows contain '999999.99' — which are QA orders, not real data.", "implication": "The raw `revenue` column cannot be averaged directly because it is a string. Also, the six QA orders with '999999.99' will distort the mean if not removed. Therefore, the analysis must first clean the revenue column by removing commas and filtering out QA orders before computing the mean."}
function.name: note_finding
